proposals.title: Empty email shows a 'required' error
proposals.rationale:
validateEmail() returns 'required' for an empty value (src/validation.ts); the field renders

once touched.

proposals.title: Malformed email shows an 'invalid-email' error
proposals.rationale: validateEmail() returns 'invalid-email' when the value fails emailPattern (src/validation.ts).

proposals.title: Weak password shows a 'weak-password' error
proposals.rationale: validatePassword() requires len>=8 + a digit + a symbol (src/validation.ts).

proposals.title: Confirm != password shows a 'mismatch' error
proposals.rationale: validateConfirm(confirm, password) compares the two fields (src/validation.ts).

proposals.title: Bad promo code shows an 'invalid-code' error on blur
proposals.rationale: validatePromo() rejects a non-empty promo that fails ^[A-Z0-9]{6}$ (src/validation.ts).

proposals.title: Submit is blocked while the form is invalid (button disabled)
proposals.rationale: The submit button is disabled={!allValid || submitting}; onSubmit early-returns when !allValid (src/pages/Signup.tsx). A non-transition gate, so it has no target state.

proposals.title: Valid submit POSTs /api/signup and shows a loading state
proposals.rationale: onSubmit sets submitting=true and awaits signup() (src/api.ts, src/pages/Signup.tsx); the button reads 'Creating…' while in flight.

proposals.title: 400 response shows inline server-validation error
proposals.rationale: onSubmit sets serverError from res.body.errors.email on a 400 (src/pages/Signup.tsx); maps to OpenAPI 400.

proposals.title: 409 response shows 'email already registered' error
proposals.rationale: onSubmit sets serverError to the taken-email message on a 409 (src/pages/Signup.tsx); maps to OpenAPI 409.

proposals.title: 500 response shows a retry error
proposals.rationale: onSubmit falls through to the generic error message on a 500 (src/pages/Signup.tsx); maps to OpenAPI 500.

proposals.title: 429 response shows a rate-limit toast
proposals.rationale: onSubmit sets a 'slow down' toast on a 429 (src/pages/Signup.tsx); maps to OpenAPI 429.

proposals.title: Each failed submit increments the attempts counter
proposals.rationale: onSubmit calls setAttempts(a => a + 1) on every non-201 response (src/pages/Signup.tsx); the 4th attempt routes to /locked (static edge guard attempts>=3). A pure state change, so no target state node.
